text: Honey never spoils. Archaeologists have found pots of honey in ancient Egyptian tombs that are over 3,000 years old and still perfectly edible!
A group of flamingos is called a 'flamboyance'.
Octopuses have three hearts: two pump blood through the gills, and one pumps blood through the rest of the body.
The longest time between two twins being born is 87 days! Beatrix and Evangeline were born prematurely at 23 weeks. Evangeline passed away three months later.
Polar bears have black skin under their white fur, which helps them absorb and retain heat from the sun.
There are more possible iterations of a game of chess than there are atoms in the known universe.
Hawaii moves 7.5 centimeters closer to Alaska every year.
The fingerprints of koalas are so indistinguishable from humans that they have on occasion been confused at crime scenes.
Bananas are berries, but strawberries are not. In botanical terms, bananas qualify as berries, while strawberries are considered aggregate fruits.
A day on Venus is longer than its year. Venus takes about 243 Earth days to rotate on its axis, while it only takes about 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun.
The Great Wall of China is not visible from space with the naked eye. Despite the common belief, astronauts have reported that it's difficult to see without aid.
The voices of Mickey Mouse and Minnie Mouse were once married in real life. Wayne Allwine, the voice of Mickey, and Russi Taylor, the voice of Minnie, were married for almost 20 years.
Cows have best friends and can become stressed when they're separated from them. They form strong social bonds with certain herd members.
The Eiffel Tower can grow up to 15 cm (6 inches) taller during the summer due to the expansion of the iron structure caused by heat.
The unicorn is the national animal of Scotland. It was chosen for its association with purity and strength, as well as its legendary status.
The average person will spend six months of their life waiting for red lights to turn green.
Hawaii is the only U.S. state that grows coffee commercially.
The total weight of all the ants on Earth is estimated to be roughly equal to the total weight of all the humans on Earth.
A day on Mars is only slightly longer than a day on Earth. A Martian day, called a 'sol,' is about 24.6 hours long.

There's a species of jellyfish known as Turritopsis dohrnii, or the 'immortal jellyfish,' which is capable of reverting back to its juvenile form after reaching maturity, effectively making it potentially immortal.
The world's oldest known living tree is a bristlecone pine named Methuselah, which is over 4,800 years old.
A single strand of spaghetti is called a 'spaghetto.'
The honeybee is the only insect that produces food humans eat.
The largest desert in the world is not the Sahara but Antarctica.
A bolt of lightning is six times hotter than the surface of the sun.
Humpback whales create complex songs that can last for up to 20 minutes and be heard underwater for miles.
The Mantis Shrimp, a marine crustacean, has 12-16 types of color receptors in its eyes, allowing it to see a far wider spectrum of colors than humans.
The planet Uranus rotates almost completely on its side, making it appear to roll along its orbital path.
In 2006, a cat named Stubbs was elected as the honorary mayor of Talkeetna, Alaska, and served for 20 years.
Some cats are allergic to humans. This condition is rare but can cause sneezing and itchy eyes in cats when they are around certain people.
In 1977, a 13-year-old boy named David Peterson successfully launched a petition to have the name of a newly discovered planet changed from 'Uranus' to 'Urectum'.
